reviews.text: Been coming here for years with our bunny and two cats - we’ve always gotten great help. A special thank you to Melanie and Susanne for always being so lovely and supportive.

Wow unbelievable staff and service beyond expectations. We had a sick dog while traveling through Europe and they were more then welcoming to fit us into. The vet who saw Lucas was fantastic and put my fiance at ease.
Always friendly and helpful, such a nice Dierenkliniek. My puppy is always happy to go there, never stressful for him.
It is so nice to see how much love they have for the animals here. You can leave your pet here with peace of mind.
Kind, attentive and professional care for of all varieties of pets and their health needs. The vets and staff here have been a great source of advice and ongoing support for me and my doggo.
They have been lovely throughout all my dog’s life. Working extra hours to attend urgent care, always very kind to the dogs and ourselves. I will always be thankful to them.
Helped quickly, good aftercare. All in all: top-notch!

A dog hit by a car was brought here in great pain and some panic. He was treated immediately and received good care after sedation, including scans and further consultation.

Ultimately, he was very lucky and sustained relatively minor injuries that were sutured on the spot. On the advice of the clinic, he stayed a few hours longer to monitor him.

Although he was in a lot of pain, I noticed that thanks to their loving approach (okay, and some pain relief too...), he remained very calm while they were working on his injuries. Furthermore, I found everyone at the clinic, from the doctor to the assistant to the receptionist, to come across as both warm and competent. You can come here with peace of mind.
Top!

Took an excellent care of both of my cats! One of them had very bad issues with bladder and all team took amazing care while having him in the clinic before and after surgery! Also always called and updated about everything! Couldn’t be more happy about all the care and love they gave to him! Thank you!
I find it a pleasant and highly professional approach to veterinarians. And in my case, a mild ulcer is present, which is good for my large dog, who is sensitive to it.
The best in town haha ​​good doctors and friendly

We’ve only had a great experience at this clinic. The vets are super thorough and caring. We were also very impressed with the aftercare and the phone call to check up on our dog. We always feel seen and heard when taking our dogs. Highly recommend.
Just good. Take the time
Friendly, knowledgeable people.
Great vet, does everything to keep my sweet old dog on his feet
A good veterinarian.

When a dog (or person) has low platelets (REGARDLESS OF THE CIRCUMSTANCES OR WHATEVER), they need LONG-TERM treatment (one month) of corticosteroids and antibiotics. I later found this out from other (knowledgeable) veterinarians, because this clinic had no idea what to do and gave me a 10-day treatment.
My dog ​​and life partner died because of these people's negligence. The worst part? They blamed me, saying I didn't want to spend any money. No matter what the excuses or what they say, my dog ​​needed LONG-TERM TREATMENT AND you didn't give her that. You are responsible for my dog's death. The most important thing (for you) is that the bill was paid on time.

What other advice, sorry?!?!?
Your advice was 10 days of corticosteroids and antibiotics. You are incompetent. Period.

I'll say it again:

When a dog (or person) has low platelets (REGARDLESS OF THE CIRCUMSTANCES OR WHATSOEVER), they must receive LONG-TERM treatment (1 month) with corticosteroids and antibiotics. PERIOD!!!

PD: With 30 days of antibiotics and corticosteroids, my dog ​​would be fine.

Your response only demonstrates your negligence and lack of professionalism.
Sadly, I had to have my sweet little girl Fleurtje put to sleep. The ladies were very kind to me and my cat. I even received a memorial card, which did me good.
The best veterinarian in Amsterdam

Friendly, helpful, and human.
They took care of my sick dog for a couple years before he passed away, when they also helped us and were very considerate.
It was so nice that I was there to have our dog put to sleep. Super nice staff who took the time for you, even though it was closing time. Definitely recommended to go there.
They have always been helpful and kind when take my dog for his annual vaccinations and exams. Also good at giving advice on how to care for him.
You have to pay directly, you can come quite quickly . They accepted me as new customer for my dog.
Great animal clinic, they really take the time for your pet.
I love this vet! They charge fair proce, are friendly and really accommodating. I recommend highly
I have an old cat so it’s sometimes hard to take care of her and I’ve gotten nothing but understanding as well as clear communication from Dierenkliniek de Wetering. I cannot recommend them enough.
